description: Read the blockchains Yutai covers, each with its tokenizers, stocks, tokenized value, supply and holder figures, and the newest health reading beside them: the live lag in seconds from the safe head to the slowest live token, and the share of its history the backfill has read as a percentage. A chain still catching up shows a backfill share below 100 beside a short live lag; a chain with no reading answers no figure.
name: list_chains
title: List chains
